title: Writing Unit Tests
learning_objectives: Write unittest.TestCase classes with assertEqual and assertRaises
Choose test cases that cover normal, edge and error behaviour
Explain how tests catch bugs, using deliberately broken versions (mutants)
Know when to replace slow or external dependencies with fakes or mocks
hints: Each mutant breaks one rule; write one test per rule from the statement.
Include `self.assertEqual(self.slugify(""), "")` and a punctuation case such as `"a!b"`→`"a-b"`.

failure_feedback.advice: One of your expected values is wrong: check it against the rules in the statement.
Add a test with upper-case input.
Add a test with two or more separators in a row, e.g. `"a,  b"`.
Add a test whose input starts or ends with punctuation or spaces.
Add a test containing digits, which must be kept.
Add a test with punctuation between letters, such as `"a!b"`.
Add a test for the empty string.
